typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ReportName as string ('pfoxd105d vSphere World'),
	ClusterAllocation_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Name as string,
		{Interval Breakdown} as string,
		DataCenter as string,
		{Number of Hosts} as string,
		{Number of Virtual Guests} as string,
		{Number of Powered on Guests} as string,
		{Total CPU Cores} as string,
		{Allocated vCPUs} as string,
		{Powered on vCPUs} as string,
		{Total RAM} as string,
		{Total RAM - Overhead} as string,
		{Allocated RAM} as string,
		{Powered on RAM} as string,
		{Total Disk Space} as string,
		{Allocated Disk Space} as string,
		{Allocated Disk Space + Overhead} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> Clusterallocation0
Clusterallocation0 derive(report_name = toString($ReportName),
		importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Number_of_Hosts as string,
		Number_of_Virtual_Guests as string,
		Powered_on_vCPUs as string,
		Interval_Breakdown as string,
		Allocated_RAM as string,
		Number_of_Powered_on_Guests as string,
		Total_RAM as string,
		Allocated_Disk_Space___Overhead as string,
		Name as string,
		Total_CPU_Cores as string,
		Powered_on_RAM as string,
		DataCenter as string,
		Total_Disk_Space as string,
		Allocated_vCPUs as string,
		report_name as string,
		{Total_RAM_-_Overhead} as string,
		Allocated_Disk_Space as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Number_of_Hosts = {Number of Hosts},
		Number_of_Virtual_Guests = {Number of Virtual Guests},
		Powered_on_vCPUs = {Powered on vCPUs},
		Interval_Breakdown = {Interval Breakdown},
		Allocated_RAM = {Allocated RAM},
		Number_of_Powered_on_Guests = {Number of Powered on Guests},
		Total_RAM = {Total RAM},
		Allocated_Disk_Space___Overhead = {Allocated Disk Space + Overhead},
		Name,
		Total_CPU_Cores = {Total CPU Cores},
		Powered_on_RAM = {Powered on RAM},
		DataCenter,
		Total_Disk_Space = {Total Disk Space},
		Allocated_vCPUs = {Allocated vCPUs},
		report_name,
		{Total_RAM_-_Overhead} = {Total RAM - Overhead},
		Allocated_Disk_Space = {Allocated Disk Space}),
	partitionFileNames:[($ClusterAllocation_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> ClusterAllocation
